digest.component_or_area: LLM model-class config schema and resolver
propositions: Add three config slots (trivial, standard, frontier) each accepting model, provider, endpoint, and an optional fallback array, parsed from the existing layered config precedence (CLI > env > file > default).
Expose a resolver mapping class name to a provider-qualified model string, reusing infer_provider when provider is omitted so bare model ids behave as today.

An unset slot resolves to today's defaults (frontier=claude-opus-4-8, standard=claude-sonnet-4-6, trivial=claude-haiku-4-5), preserving current behaviour bit-for-bit and serving as the rollback story.
A slot or fallback entry containing api_key is rejected loudly, enforcing the env-only secrets boundary; fallback is config-file-only with no env form.
The fallback entry schema equals a slot's fields minus fallback and is non-recursive: a nested fallback is a typed config error, and fallback=[] equals an absent fallback key.
load_class_slots reads the model_classes sub-table from the merged config and returns resolved slots, making the parser reachable from real configuration and returning defaults when no table exists.
